failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

invariant_crossChainCapNeverExceeded().notice: After every deploy, totalPendingCrossChain must remain <=         maxPendingCrossChainBps * totalAssets / 10_000.         (The handler's deployCrossChainAction only deploys when the cap         permits; this invariant catches any code path that bypasses the guard.)

invariant_noDilutionFromOtherUsers().notice: For each actor: if they held shares BEFORE another actor's action,         their pro-rata USDC value must not have INCREASED.         Check: preValue = preAssets * preShares / preSupply                curValue  = curAssets  * preShares / curSupply         Dilution would mean curValue < preValue (another actor's deposit         added assets to the pool, which should never decrease an existing         holder's share value; a redeem increases others' per-share value —         that is also fine).         Formally: preAssets/preSupply <= curAssets/curSupply + epsilon         i.e. another actor's action must not lower the exchange rate for         existing holders (beyond ERC-4626 rounding).

invariant_totalAssetsAccounting().notice: vault.totalAssets() == idleBalance + totalDeployed - lockedProfit         within 2 USDC rounding tolerance.

invariant_totalPendingCrossChain_consist.notice: The on-chain totalPendingCrossChain must equal the handler's ghost         sum of still-open nonces.  Any settled/written-off nonce is removed         from both.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).
